# SLA Group Resources

> Resources shared in a sex addiction recovery therapy group: books, podcasts, apps, 12-step groups, and worksheets for people in recovery, partners, and couples. Nobody pays to be listed. Not medical advice.

## Group session
The group meets through BetterHelp's group sessions; attendees must be BetterHelp members. How to register: https://www.betterhelp.com/groups-faq/

## Main page
- [Sex addiction recovery resources](https://www.slagroupresources.com/): the full list, with each item tagged for people in recovery, partners, or couples.

## Trackers
- [Feelings check-in](https://www.slagroupresources.com/feelings-check-in.html): a private feelings wheel and log.
- [90-day tracker](https://www.slagroupresources.com/90-day-tracker.html): daily check-ins with 30, 60, and 90 day milestones.
- [Coping skills log](https://www.slagroupresources.com/coping-skills-log.html): an online version of the group's coping skills log.
Tracker entries are encrypted in the browser with the user's own passphrase; no email or account.

## Sections
- [Find support](https://www.slagroupresources.com/#support): our recovery group sessions (BetterHelp membership required) and 12-step fellowships (SAA, SLAA).
- [Tools from group](https://www.slagroupresources.com/#practices): bringing the session home (the person in recovery takes notes in group and shares them with their partner), rebuilding trust, handling urges (safety plan, reaching out, HALT, riding the wave), everyday mood basics.
- [Books](https://www.slagroupresources.com/#books): Patrick Carnes (Out of the Shadows, Facing the Shadow), Out of the Doghouse, Help Her Heal, Dopamine Nation, and more.
- [Podcasts](https://www.slagroupresources.com/#podcasts): Porn, Betrayal, Sex and the Experts (PBSE), Unhooked, and others.
- [Apps](https://www.slagroupresources.com/#apps): Covenant Eyes, Ever Accountable, Canopy, Truple, Brick, and others.
- [Group files](https://www.slagroupresources.com/#files): Healthy Sexual Decision Framework, Feelings Wheel, Coping Skills Log, 90-Day Detox Summary.
- [Common questions](https://www.slagroupresources.com/#faq): what a 90-day detox is, and what "disclosure is better than discovery" means.

## Crisis
In the U.S., call or text 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline) or call 911 in an emergency.
